title: Task Scheduler
description: Schedule and manage recurring or one-shot tasks
summary: Schedule and manage recurring or one-shot tasks
offersHint: Schedule and manage recurring or one-shot tasks · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://cron.memoryapi.org/mcp

toolsPreview.name: schedule_task
toolsPreview.description: Register a persistent cron schedule that runs even when your agent session ends. Specify a URL to call, how often, and for how long.

toolsPreview.name: check_schedule
toolsPreview.description: Check the status of a cron schedule — is it active, when does it next run, how many times has it executed?

toolsPreview.name: cancel_schedule
toolsPreview.description: Cancel an active cron schedule to stop all future executions immediately.

toolsPreview.name: get_execution_history
toolsPreview.description: View recent execution history for a schedule — status codes, response previews, and timing.
